title: Lake Mead, the Nation’s Largest Reservoir, Is Smaller Than Ever
summary: Water levels in the reservoir, which sits behind the Hoover Dam, are at record lows. A continued drop would imperil water supplies for millions of people and cut electricity from the dam.
